claim_summary: For fixed annular data and interaction distance \(R>0\), the unique inner interface radius is strictly decreasing with dimension and has the sharp high-dimensional offset \(\frac{M_1}{M_2}\frac{R_1}{n-2}(\frac{R_1}{R_1+R})^{n-2}\) to leading order.
integrity: The proof is an exact consequence of the primary source interface equations, using an integral representation, monotonicity in a continuous dimension parameter, and an exact asymptotic identity. No finite experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim is for the rotationally invariant two-species limiting free-boundary configuration with fixed positive data and strict gap \(R_1+R<R_2\); it does not cover nonradial domains, other kernels, the endpoint gap, or finite positive competition parameter.
title: Dimension-monotone pinning of annular long-range segregation interfaces
